name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: Between Ivory and Onyx, one goes with Americano and the other with Toffee.
Between Hazelnut and Toffee, one goes with Amber and the other with Ivory.
Either Mocha goes with Onyx, or Danish goes with Toffee — but not both.
Ava goes with exactly two of Espresso, Donut, Maple, and Amber.
Either Cara goes with Mocha or Onyx goes with Espresso.

chain: Start by assuming Americano goes with Amber.
Americano goes with Amber, so it can't also go with Ivory.
Americano goes with Amber, so it can't also go with Onyx.
Amber goes with Americano, so Espresso can't go with Amber.
Amber goes with Americano, so Mocha can't go with Amber.
The clues force Toffee to go with Ivory.
The clues force Toffee to go with Onyx.
…but now the clue “Between Ivory and Onyx, one goes with Americano and the other with Toffee” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Americano does not go with Amber.
